rounds.reasoning_summary:
**Creating clear instructions for team**

After the deadline, if a customer responds, the team has to manually recreate the request in the new system. I think recommending an update of the status before the deadline could help when they expect a reply soon. 

So, I want to craft clear instructions. If it's likely they'll get a response before next Friday, they can leave it in Pending Customer, but must change the status to In Progress or Waiting on Internal upon receiving the reply—importantly before the close of business next Friday. If there’s uncertainty about a response before the deadline, it may be better to change the status proactively to ensure migration.
**Drafting focused instructions**

After the deadline, anything still in Pending Customer won't migrate and needs manual recreation after go-live. If a customer responds after the deadline, don’t wait—manually recreate it in the new system or create a migration plan. If you expect a customer’s reply before next Friday, you can leave the ticket in Pending Customer for now. However, make sure to change the status to In Progress or Waiting on Internal once you receive a reply and before close of business next Friday.
**Finalizing clear ticket instructions**

If you expect a customer to reply before next Friday, you can leave the ticket in Pending Customer for now but must update it to In Progress or Waiting on Internal before close of business next Friday once the reply arrives for migration. If you don’t expect a reply before the deadline, change the ticket now to the correct active status and ensure there’s an assigned owner for automatic migration. Remember, tickets left in Pending Customer at close of business next Friday will not migrate, and any responses after then will require manual recreation in the new system after go-live.
rounds.response: Jordan — If you expect the customer to reply before next Friday, you may leave the ticket in "Pending Customer" now but must update it to "In Progress" or "Waiting on Internal" (and ensure an assigned owner) as soon as the reply arrives and before COB next Friday so it will be migrated. If you do not expect a reply before the deadline, change the ticket now to the correct active status and confirm an assigned owner so it migrates automatically. Any ticket left in "Pending Customer" at COB next Friday will NOT be migrated; if the customer responds after the deadline, the ticket will need to be manually recreated in the new system after go‑live.
